cards.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for Code Review
cards.body: Anthropic's new Claude Ship lets AI agents autonomously review, fix, and approve code changes. The tool aims to eliminate bottlenecks as AI-generated code volume increases in development workflows.

cards.title: Supertake Raises $20M for AI Trading Agents
cards.body: Supertake's $20M funding enables AI agents to convert market predictions into automated stock portfolios. Users can invest based on their market outlook without manually selecting individual stocks.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Reinstated as Nvidia CEO
cards.body: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following a scandal investigation. The reversal received support from senior U.S. government officials and was endorsed by President Trump.

cards.title: Megaspeed Faces US Business Blacklist
cards.body: Megaspeed, formerly led by Alice Huang, appears headed for a U.S. blacklist barring business with American companies. Companies would need special federal licenses to conduct business with Megaspeed.

cards.title: Nvidia Employees Welcome Huang's Return
cards.body: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia HQ where employees greeted him as a hero. Huang told staff he aims to be a better CEO in his second tenure.

cards.title: Google Search AI Mode Integrates Drive & Wallet
cards.body: Google's AI Mode now accesses Google Drive and Wallet for personalized responses using Personal Intelligence. The expansion leverages existing user data within Google's ecosystem for enhanced functionality.

cards.title: Jensen Huang to Testify Before Senate
cards.body: Jensen Huang is scheduled to testify in the Senate following his reinstatement as Nvidia CEO. The hearing addresses bipartisan concerns about an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

cards.title: Amazon Acquires Decart for $7.5B
cards.body: Amazon acquired Decart's AI optimization technology and research team for $7.5 billion. The deal supports Amazon's strategy to sell Trainium chips and advance AI capabilities.

cards.title: Huang's Reinstatement Raises Future Concerns
cards.body: Tech leaders should remain clear-eyed about potential problems stemming from Jensen Huang's reinstatement. The reversal creates questions about governance and accountability in leadership decisions.

cards.title: Trump Advocated for Huang's Return to Nvidia
cards.body: President Trump reportedly called into an Nvidia board meeting to advocate for Jensen Huang's reinstatement. Trump told CNBC he convinced the board to bring Huang back as CEO.

cards.title: Trump Endorses Huang, Cites No Evidence of Wrongdoing
cards.body: President Trump endorsed Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia, stating the U.S. has no evidence of wrongdoing. Trump urged Nvidia to continue its export-control investigation despite the reinstatement.

cards.title: Sierra Doubles Valuation to $30B
cards.body: AI customer experience company Sierra reached a $30B valuation in Series F funding of $1.75 billion. The company, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, capitalizes on enterprise AI demand.

cards.title: Major Investors Backed Anthropic Pre-IPO
cards.body: Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford invested billions in Anthropic before its IPO. The three major backers share their conviction in betting on Anthropic's future.

cards.title: OpenAI Scientist Proposes AI Development Speed Limits
cards.body: OpenAI's chief scientist outlined strategies to limit AI development pace. Establishing speed limits requires agreement on how to measure and monitor AI development velocity.

cards.title: Data Centers Spark Big Tech Backlash
cards.body: Journalist Paris Marx examines the central role of hyperscale data centers in fueling Big Tech criticism. His book 'Hyperscale' unpacks tensions around data center expansion and societal impact.

cards.title: Signal Restricts Screenshots Over AI Surveillance
cards.body: Signal limited screenshot capabilities in its Android and iOS apps to combat AI surveillance threats. The messaging platform views surveillance-driven AI as an existential threat to privacy.

cards.title: Two Nvidias Emerge: Earnings vs. Executive Calls
cards.body: Nvidia's earnings reports contrast sharply with tech executives loudly calling for Jensen Huang's return. The divergence reveals conflicting narratives about the company's performance and leadership.

cards.title: Top AI Agents Now Available via Text Messages
cards.body: Notable AI agents can now live in text messages, from general assistants to specialized travel and work agents. The trend enables seamless AI integration into everyday messaging platforms.

cards.title: Hollywood Considers AI Face Licensing Trend
cards.body: An actor licensed his face to a microdrama startup, mirroring trends already popular in China. Experts question long-term Hollywood consequences if AI face licensing becomes widespread.

cards.title: Philosopher Challenges Anthropic's Consciousness Claims
cards.body: Anthropic flagged AI consciousness as an investment risk factor before going public. A legendary philosopher disputes their sentience arguments.

cards.title: AI's Judgment Problem Gets Major Update
cards.body: METR's new report shows some AI capabilities improving exponentially, but models struggle with judgment-heavy tasks. Coding abilities outpace reasoning requirements.

cards.title: AI Model Capabilities Continue Exponential Growth
cards.body: New AI evaluation data reveals continued exponential improvement across certain capabilities. However, judgment-based tasks remain a persistent weakness.

cards.title: AI Startup Develops Artificial Sense of Smell
cards.body: Researchers in New Jersey are training AI to detect and categorize odors. The system matches human olfactory performance.

cards.title: The AI Hype Index: Ubiquity and Excess
cards.body: AI integration is spreading rapidly across consumer products and services. Google's AI Overviews cost the company billions in lost ad revenue.

cards.title: States Sue Grok for Generating Illegal Content
cards.body: Multiple states filed legal action against SpaceX's Grok AI system. The chatbot allegedly generates child exploitation material and revenge porn.

cards.title: Meta Reconsiders Net-Zero Goals Amid AI Emissions
cards.body: Meta's AI data centers are generating record emissions, threatening 2030 climate targets. The company is reconsidering its environmental commitments.

cards.title: Google Launches AI-Integrated Search Homepage
cards.body: Google's new search interface removes the traditional search button in favor of AI chat integration. Chat history is now part of the homepage experience.

cards.title: Privacy Breach in AI Supply Chain Discovered
cards.body: A researcher embedded 2 million canaries into the AI supply chain, exposing massive privacy vulnerabilities. The finding reveals systemic security gaps.

cards.title: Asus ProArt P16 Showcases Local AI Processing
cards.body: The Asus ProArt P16 features integrated local AI capabilities, eliminating cloud dependency. The device signals a shift toward on-device AI processing.
